[quote=dushkaria;60866295][b]Negotiations?[/b]

[i]Possibly for the first time in decades, the nation of Dushkaria seeks to do diplomacy with [nation]Vespurias[/nation]; this action seems to have been spurned on by them contacting Dushkaria first. Dushkari diplomats, albeit new to their duties, seek to establish a deal that would provide mutual benefits and not disturb the fragile economy. If these talks were successful in some way, they could open Dushkaria up to the world and lead to changes in Dushkari society.[/i][/quote]
Vespurias had welcome Dushkaria to the Second Trade, Ordinance & Security Act for signing, and now would wish to further strengthen relations. An offer for at least 3 embassies in each nation as well cultural exchange programs is offered, and as a sign of friendship, Vespurias sends a phoenix to the nation.

[quote=vespurias;61003895]Vespurias had welcome Dushkaria to the Second Trade, Ordinance & Security Act for signing, and now would wish to further strengthen relations. An offer for at least 3 embassies in each nation as well cultural exchange programs is offered, and as a sign of friendship, Vespurias sends a phoenix to the nation.[/quote]
[i]The woefully understaffed diplomatic office was taken by surprise; all of these will be agreed upon, and further discussions are open. A potential meeting between the governments can be scheduled, and construction of embassies can begin immediately. [/i]
Hallo gang.

[quote=dushkaria;61003931][i]The woefully understaffed diplomatic office was taken by surprise; all of these will be agreed upon, and further discussions are open. A potential meeting between the governments can be scheduled, and construction of embassies can begin immediately. [/i][/quote]
Vespurias would schedule constructions, paid for entirely by the nation ourselves, in six different locations, for the next eight months, with similar nine month long discussions and valuing of Dushkaria, to add to the Vespurian database and update relationships and public information properly across Vespurias. A phoenix animal care manual is sent with the ambassadors, who for the moment will purchase a private property to live in until the embassies are constructed. In the meantime, it'll give time to the counterpart's foreign office to gather manpower, and to help them, a few senior retired diplomats would go and offer to aid for the next ten months.
